# FTSE 100 (^FTSE) close for 2026-10-17: research brief

## 1. Resolution source
- 2026-10-09: the code-collected Yahoo ^FTSE close is **10,552.10**. Investing.com shows 10,552.05, up 110.45 points or 1.06% on the day, with a range of 10,441.50 to 10,577.33. [Investing.com](https://www.investing.com/indices/uk-100-historical-data), [Yahoo](https://finance.yahoo.com/quote/%5EFTSE/)
- I could not fetch the Yahoo page directly. The small gap (about 0.05 points) between the code value and Investing.com looks like a data-vendor rounding difference.

## 2. Current status
- Nothing has settled the question yet. The index sits near the middle of the 10,000 to 11,000 question range.
- 2026-10-09: the index was about 4.0% below its 52-week high of 10,989.45. The all-time closing high is about 10,911, set in February 2026. [Investing.com](https://www.investing.com/indices/uk-100-historical-data), [AJ Bell](https://www.ajbell.co.uk/news/can-record-dividends-help-ftse-100-outrun-gilt-yields)

## 3. Recent news (newest first)
- 2026-10-09: the FTSE closed up about 1.1% at 10,552, its highest close since 30 Sep. That ended a two-day losing streak.
  - RELX rose about 4.8% and Sage about 4.3%.
  - Miners rallied on firmer copper, silver and gold (Antofagasta +5%, Fresnillo +3%).
  - Vodafone fell 4.9%, BT 2.4% and Airtel Africa 6.3% after SpaceX agreed to buy spectrum for Starlink Mobile.
  - Oil eased. The index gained 0.9% over the week. [Trading Economics](https://tradingeconomics.com/united-kingdom/stock-market/news/590929), [BBN Times](https://www.bbntimes.com/global-economy/ftse-100-climbs-to-10-552-05-as-software-and-mining-stocks-rally-and-oil-eases-while-telecoms-slide-on-spacex-threat)
- 2026-10-08: the UK 10-year gilt yield reportedly reached about 5.51%, its highest since July 2007. I could not confirm this date-specific figure from a source dated before the cutoff. [Vantage](https://www.vantagemarkets.com/market-analysis/ftse-100-today-banks-gilt-yields-uk100-october-13-2026/)
- 2026-10-07: gilt yields climbed as markets priced in a Bank of England rate **hike**. I could not open the article itself. [Invezz](https://invezz.com/news/2026/10/07/ftse-100-outlook-gilt-yields-climb-as-markets-price-in-a-boe-rate-hike/)
- About 2026-10-01: the FTSE fell 177 points (1.68%) to about 10,428, its steepest one-day drop since May. The 30-year gilt yield broke above 6%. [Share Talk](https://www.share-talk.com/ftse-100-falls-1-7-as-uk-30-year-gilt-yield-breaks-6.md)
- Q3 2026 context: gilt yields are near their highest since 2007, driven by Middle East and US-Iran tensions, UK fiscal worries and sticky inflation. Elevated oil supports the index's energy majors but adds pressure for BoE tightening. [AJ Bell](https://www.ajbell.co.uk/news/can-record-dividends-help-ftse-100-outrun-gilt-yields), [StoneX](https://www.stonex.com/en-gb/news-and-analysis/ftse-100-today-oil-rates-and-stocks-to-watch/)

|---|---|

| p10 | 10,392 |
| p25 | 10,482 |
| **p50** | **10,587** |
| p75 | 10,700 |

| p95 | 10,844 |

- The middle 50% band (p25 to p75) is about ±1.1% around spot. The 90% band (p5 to p95) is about -2.5% / +2.8%.
- Recent volatility looks a little above normal: there was a 1.7% one-day drop on about 10-01 and moves of ±1% are common. The past 2 weeks traded between about 10,428 and 10,600.
- The resolving horizon is 5 sessions, not 6, so the true spread is a bit narrower than the baseline (about 9% narrower in standard-deviation terms).
- The 10,000 and 11,000 bounds are about 5.2% below and 4.2% above spot. Historically, a 5-session move that large is rare (under about 2%).

## 5. Other forecasts
- I found no Polymarket, Kalshi or Manifold market on the FTSE 100 close for mid-October 2026.
- I found no dated analyst point target for this week.

## 6. Upcoming events before Friday 2026-10-16
- **UK labour-market data** (usually mid-month Tuesday, so probably about 10-13 or 10-14), plus possibly the August monthly GDP. Exact dates are not confirmed. The ONS lists July GDP on 11 Sep and September GDP on 12 Nov, and I could not find the August release date. [ONS](https://www.ons.gov.uk/releases/gdpmonthlyestimateukjuly2026), [ONS](https://www.ons.gov.uk/releases/gdpmonthlyestimateukseptember2026)
- **UK September CPI** probably comes out about 10-21, after resolution. I could not confirm the date. Expectations ahead of it may still move gilts.
- **US Q3 earnings season** begins with the big banks (usually around the middle of the month), and **US CPI** for September is expected mid-month. Neither date is confirmed.
- **BoE speeches and gilt-yield moves:** the 10-year near 5.5% and the 30-year above 6% are a key downside risk.
- **Oil and US-Iran headlines:** these cut both ways for the index, since higher oil lifts BP and Shell but adds inflation pressure.
- **Commodity prices** (copper, gold, silver) matter for the heavily weighted miners.
- **Telecoms:** Vodafone and BT could stay under pressure from Starlink competition.
- **UK Budget:** I could not confirm whether it falls within the window. It appears to come later in October.
